messages:
taylor: Heads-up — tomorrow 2026-03-24 03:00-04:00 UTC we're running a dry-run for an embedding read-replica promotion + embed-cache drain that crosses us-west -> eu-west routing. Expected impact: brief 1–2m blips of 5xx for non-critical embedding reads; standard text gen routes should be unaffected.

maya: Can we get an SLO temporary adjustment for embedding reads (p99 500ms -> 1200ms) during the window? Trying to avoid late-night pages.

samir: Plan is canary first (3% traffic) + synthetic soak against canaries. We'll also pause background jobs (job-service) for ~20m centered on the run.

kevin: Rollback plan?

taylor: Rollback = abort promotions + scale old replicas back up. Abort criteria: sustained canary error rate > 2% for 2 minutes or any unexplained embedding corruption. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-promotion

opsbot: automated schedule created: maintenance-id m-20260324-embed-dryrun, creator taylor, window 2026-03-24T03:00Z-2026-03-24T04:00Z

maya: Also please ask Product to gate non-critical batches (embedding-reindex, nightly evals) during the window — don't want reindex to spike RPS. @product

lina (product): acked. We'll gate evals and pause reindexing 02:50-04:10 UTC.

samir: Canary watch commands: 
```
kubectl get pods -l app=embed-canary -n inference -o wide
kubectl logs -f deployment/embed-canary -n inference | grep "embed_read" --line-buffered
```

kevin: I'll be on-call for rollback. +1 from eng-sre. Anyone else joining the war room?

taylor: @maya + @samir will join. Opsbot will auto-post progress every 5m.

opsbot: scheduled synthetic load: 3m soak at t+10m, target 3k rps to canary, abort if 5xx > 1%

maya: Small ask — ensure KV cache prefill completes by 02:45 so control group is warm.

taylor: noted; prefill job scheduled 02:15.

samir: One last check: security sign-off for cross-region key access done? @security

oliver (security): Confirmed. KMS access pattern approved, audit logging enabled.

taylor: Great. If no objections we'll proceed with dry-run as scheduled. Please react with :thumbsup: to acknowledge.
